data.name: Actions.SetDevices.Description
data.value: Sets the system's default output device, input device, or both.

data.name: Actions.SetDevices.Failed
data.value: Could not switch the audio device: {error}

data.name: Actions.SetDevices.Input.Description
data.value: The microphone to record from. Leave on "Don't change" to keep the current one.

data.name: Actions.SetDevices.MoveStreams.Description
data.value: Also moves apps that are already playing or recording onto the new device (Linux).

data.name: Actions.SetDevices.NothingSelected
data.value: Pick an output device, an input device, or both.

data.name: Actions.SetDevices.Output.Description
data.value: The speakers or headphones to play through. Leave on "Don't change" to keep the current one.

data.name: Widgets.AudioDevices.Description
data.value: Lists your outputs and inputs and switches the system default with a tap. Sized for 4x3.

data.name: Widgets.AudioDevices.Config.Overflow.Label
data.value: When there are more devices than fit

data.name: Widgets.AudioDevices.Config.Overflow.Description
data.value: Shrink every row to fit the tile, or keep rows full size and scroll the column.

data.name: Widgets.AudioDevices.Config.MoveStreams.Description
data.value: When you switch, also move apps that are already playing or recording onto the new device (Linux).

data.name: Widgets.AudioDevices.Config.HiddenOutputs.Description
data.value: Outputs that should not appear on this tile.

data.name: Widgets.AudioDevices.Config.HiddenInputs.Description
data.value: Inputs that should not appear on this tile.

data.name: Widgets.AudioDevices.Config.Meters.Description
data.value: Show a live level bar under each device. Linux skips Bluetooth microphones so headsets don't drop into call mode. On Windows an input only moves while an app is recording from it. Not available on macOS.
